text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
What do you want for your birthday?<n>Don't be shy
now, you can ask for<n>anything.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... You say that every year, andyou always really mean anything,don't you?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I got it! Dia, I want you to keep<n>running with me,
now and forever!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Forever, you say... Hehe. You're<n>being awfully
greedy today, Kita.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Really? Y-you think? This is the only<n>thing I'm
asking for though...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, but I don't mind. After all, I'm<n>guilty of being
just as greedy as you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: When I heard your request, my firstthought was that I wished you'd said"keep running with me every day,"you know? ♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Every day? You got it! I'd like<n>that too! Can I
change my request<n>real quick?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks, Dia. Every time I need you,<n>you always
rise to the challenge and<n>more.
